senses.gloss: (b. h. √בד , v. בדד) to split, break into, penetrate.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:9">Keth. XIII, 9</cite> <he>הנוה היפה בּוֹדֵק</he> the removal to a better residence (and style of living) penetrates (the body and creates disease); v.
ib. 110ᵇ מאי ב׳ כדשמואל וכ׳ what does bodek mean? Answ. As it is expressed by Samuel …, a change of the mode of living (v. וֶסֶת) is the beginning of abdominal disease.—Esp.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 5:1">Sot. V, 1</cite> as well as the water <he>בּוֹדְקִין אותה וכ׳</he> tries her (eventually makes her sick), so does it try him (the adulterer).
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:1">Pes. I, 1</cite> <he>ב׳ את החמץ</he> leavened bread is searched after (for the sake of removing it).
<cite ref="Pesachim 9b">Ib. 9ᵇ</cite> (<he>בית</he>) <he>בָּדוּק</he> a house which has been searched.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:6">Snh. III, 6</cite> <he>ב׳ את העדים</he> the witnesses are cross-examined.
<cite ref="Shabbat 139a:2">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite> <he>וכ׳ בְּדוֹק בדיינו</he> investigate the doings of the Israelitish judges.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:8">Keth. VII, 8</cite> <he>הוא בּוֹדְקָהּ וכ׳</he> he has her examined (as to bodily soundness) by his female relatives.

<cite ref="Ketubot 75b:8">Ib. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>חזקה אין … אא״כ בּוֹדְקוֹ</he> the presumption is that nobody will drink out of a cup, unless he has examined it (will not marry a woman before ascertaining her physical condition).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:4">Kidd. IV, 4</cite> <he>צריך לבְדוֹק אחריה וכ׳</he> must investigate her family records up to four mothers &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>אין בודקין מן וכ׳</he> no family records are searched beyond the altar, i.e. the ascertained fact of a person’s admission to priestly services is sufficient evidence of unblemished descent for marriage purposes.

<cite ref="Niddah 30b:23">Nidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>ובדקן ומצאן</he> (read <he>ובדקו ומצאו</he>) they (the scholars) examined (made a post mortem examination); <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:17">Tosef. ib. IV, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:17">Bekh. 45ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to tend, cure (plants), esp. to cover with earth or manure.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:12">Tosef. Shebi. I, 12</cite>; Y. ib. IV, 35ᵇ bot.

senses.gloss: to be examined &c. Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵇ; IX, end, 50ᵈ נ׳ השם the report was traced.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:6">Nidd. V, 6</cite> <he>נדריה נִבְדָּקִין</he> her vows are subject to examination (to find out whether she knows the import of a vow); a. fr.
